title: Jazzy Malaysian Parmigiano Curry
description: A creamy, malty curry that showcases Parmigiano-Reggiano on a gluten-free slate-tile vessel for a show‑off Malaysian dinner.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a slate-tile pan over medium heat until shimmering.
Add the minced onion and sauté until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic and grated ginger, cooking for an additional minute until fragrant.
Mix in the Malaysian red curry paste and cook for 2 minutes, allowing the flavors to bloom.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, letting it thicken slightly for 5 minutes.
Add the fresh spinach, stirring until it wilts, then fold in the cooked basmati rice.
Remove the pan from heat and stir in the grated Parmigiano-Reggiano, letting the cheese melt into a creamy sauce.
Finish with a splash of lime juice, season with salt and pepper to taste, and serve hot.
